text:
Elena (AE): Zenith Health wants a short preflight checklist for the Private/on-prem POC. They asked about GPU drivers, CUDA, k8s, and network egress. Can someone post a concise list plus the quick validation commands they can run and paste back?

Sam (SE): TL;DR matrix below. Will also include installer token option.

Marco (FieldTech): Minimal supported matrix:
- Nvidia driver: >= 525 supported; recommend >= 535 for CUDA 12.x features
- Recommended CUDA: 12.1 (11.8 OK for older stacks)
- Kernel: >= 5.15 for Ampere/Hopper stability
- container runtime: containerd 1.6+ preferred (containerd 1.5 ok), Docker 20.10 supported
- K8s: recommend 1.24-1.26 for POC; we also accept 1.23-1.27 in practice
- Required software: nvidia-container-toolkit, NVIDIA device plugin, NodeFeatureDiscovery

Jordan - Zenith IT: We're on Ubuntu 22.04, containerd 1.6, 3x A10 nodes. Secure-boot enabled. Anything special for secure-boot?

Marco (FieldTech): With secure-boot you need signed kernel modules or vendor-signed drivers. If your distro provides signed NVIDIA packages use those, otherwise infra will need to sign the modules. We'll add commands to check.

Sam (SE): Network + access notes:
- Outbound HTTPS (443) from the management node to api.redwood.ai and auth.redwood.ai for control plane callbacks
- DNS for *.redwood.ai must resolve
- For artifact pulls allow artifacts.redwood.ai (we can provide a short-lived presigned URL)
- For bootstrap we prefer an installer token (single-use, 72h expiry) rather than opening SSH; can do temporary bastion if customer requires

Marco (FieldTech): Storage: 1 NVMe per GPU or fast local SSD recommended. Suggest 150-250GB per GPU for multi-billion parameter models. IO scheduler: noop/none for NVMe.

Sam (SE): Quick validation commands to paste into the ticket (they're short):
```
$ uname -r
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv
$ nvcc --version || echo "nvcc not installed"
$ sudo systemctl status containerd || sudo systemctl status docker
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
$ curl -I https://api.redwood.ai
```

Jordan - Zenith IT: Running now, pasting outputs (redacted):
```
5.19.0-46-generic
NVIDIA-SMI 535.54 Driver Version: 535.54 CUDA Version: 12.1
nvcc not installed
containerd: active (running)
3 nodes Ready
HTTP/2 200
```

Marco (FieldTech): Looks good. Next: kube taints/tolerations — ensure GPU nodes allow our inf-serving pods (we'll send a YAML snippet with tolerations). Also confirm AppArmor on Ubuntu (ok). If RHEL/SELinux, prefer permissive for install or provide policy snippets.

Sam (SE): Security note for their security team: Private deploy keeps control-plane keys customer-managed; we integrate with customer KMS/HSMs. Installer tokens are audited and revocable. We'll attach the one-pager.

ops-bot: Installer token issued by Marco. Token TTL 72h. (token: ****redacted****)

Elena (AE): Great — I'll send this checklist to Zenith and request they paste the command outputs into the ticket. Marco/Sam, please attach the YAML and the sizing note in the ticket. Thanks! :rocket:
